method.reason: PBE0 is an explicitly documented one-parameter hybrid functional and is appropriate for a small closed-shell HCN molecule; it includes exact-exchange admixture expected to improve the description of the electronic structure relevant to NMR shielding relative to pure RHF, while remaining inexpensive for three atoms. This fixes the wavefunction as RKS for the neutral singlet.

sources.quote: PBE0 [229] PBE0 25 One-parameter hybrid version of PBE

basis.reason: def2-TZVP is a documented polarized valence triple-zeta basis. For a three-atom molecule the cost is modest, and the larger flexible basis is preferable to def2-SVP for computing the anisotropic GIAO shielding tensor and its isotropic trace. The total job remains small under the available four-core/192 MB-per-process limits.

sources.quote: def2-TZVP H–Rn def2-ECP (Rb–Rn) Polarized valence triple-\(\zeta\).

proposal.reason: The request permits RHF or PBE0 and def2-SVP or def2-TZVP. For small closed-shell HCN, PBE0/def2-TZVP gives a documented hybrid functional and flexible triple-zeta basis for total GIAO shielding while remaining computationally modest. The cited current-Run knowledge results establish the method and basis labels; this selection is not itself scientific validation.
